correctness.rationale: The fixed 36-point alphabet product [3]×[3]×[4] has Hamming distances 0,1,2,3. At 0≤r<1 it has 36 components. The radius-one clique complex is a union of 12,12,9 coordinate-line simplices intersecting at most at vertices, yielding the connected 36-vertex 75-edge graph and β1=40. At radius 2 the allowed faces are precisely independent sets of K3×K3×K4 because forbidden pairs differ in all three coordinates. An independent implementation from the metric (not the repository verifier) enumerated exactly 30,991 faces with f-vector (36,414,2028,4869,6804,6816,5184,3042,1324,396,72,6), constructed 15,447 vertex-toggle pairs, found one critical 0-cell and 96 critical dimension-three cells, and topologically sorted all 178,668 Morse-oriented Hasse incidences without a cycle. Separately read actual morse_certificate.json blob 409d734a3ed9e2f1db2f3f09740145ba881fa889 and verified each of its 30,991 face masks is legal, every lower face is present, pair list matches the vertex-toggle recipe, all 178,668 arc directions respect its complete 30,991-face order; no missing faces or wrongly ordered arcs. Hence the Forman discrete-Morse theorem proves the integral homotopy type ∨^96 S^3 (not just rational Betti numbers). From r≥3 the full 35-simplex is contractible. Since nontrivial reduced homology lives in degrees 0,1,3 on mutually disjoint radius intervals, the integral barcode has respectively 35 [0,1), 40 [1,2), 96 [2,3), no torsion. This is an exhaustive finite theorem for one fixed metric space, not an infinite parameter extrapolation.
